title: Credit record
description: One credit in the greyZ ledger. Field names match JSON Resume (jsonresume.org) where they overlap: name, position, url, startDate, endDate, summary, highlights, keywords, roles, entity. GlitchWorks talent-schema alignment is opportunistic — do not block records on it.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor tooling.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the filename stem (e.g. records/zenclip.yaml → zenclip).

name.description: Display title. JSON Resume: projects[].name, work[].position when kind is employment (see also position).

kind.description: Record class. Maps to JSON Resume sections on export (employment → work, project/asset/release → projects, publication → publications, talk → projects with type=talk, reference → references, client-engagement → work).

roles.description: JSON Resume projects[].roles — roles held on this credit.

position.description: JSON Resume work[].position. Prefer this for employment / client-engagement; roles[] for projects.

entity.description: Org, client, or affiliation. JSON Resume: work[].name, projects[].entity.

url.description: Primary public URL (JSON Resume work[].url / projects[].url).

startDate.description: JSON Resume startDate. Year, year-month, or full date.

endDate.description: JSON Resume endDate. Omit if ongoing.

status.description: Lifecycle of the work itself, not of the git record.

summary.description: JSON Resume work[].summary / publications[].summary. Export also copies this to projects[].description.

highlights.description: JSON Resume highlights — short verified bullets only.

tech.description: Tech stack (languages, tools, platforms). Not a JSON Resume field; folded into skills on export. Kept as a sibling of keywords so GlitchWorks talent records can map stack separately from topics.

location.description: JSON Resume work[].location, e.g. Riga, Latvia.

evidence.description: Supporting links. Each link has its own visibility so a public record can still redact a Linear id.

iso8601.description: JSON Resume iso8601: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

visibility.description: public = safe to publish and to include in CV export. private-redacted = stub only; export omits it.

source.description: Where the fact was checked (public URL, named document). No private repo contents.

id.description: Linear issue/project id, PR number, or other tracker key when there is no public URL.
